pages.text: Four native effects: Lightfoot (higher jump, safe fall), Glowmarked (the target glows), Sporeblind (a spore-clouded slow), and Rooted (heavy slow, no jump).
Brew each from an Awkward Potion + a native ingredient: $(br)Air Gel → Lightfoot$(br)Glow Pollen → Glowmarked$(br)Spore Sac (or Glowcap Spores) → Sporeblind$(br)Living Fiber → Rooted
The same four effects can be put on gear as enchantments — fished only from Lumenwater. See $(l:lumenwater_fishing)Lumenwater Fishing$(/l).
